summary: Verstappen battles treacherous track conditions at Austin as "unacceptable" bumps threaten to shake up the championship fight, while Antonelli pursues his maiden world title with a relaxed mindset heading into the decisive rounds. The midfield intrigue intensifies with Racing Bulls' driver lineup still uncertain, adding unpredictability to strategy and point-scoring opportunities. A dominant performance here could prove decisive in settling the championship equation before the season's final stretch.
